name: NgDRTBTreatmentRegister
title: NG DR-TB Treatment Register
description:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme DR-TB Treatment Register. One model instance represents a DR-TB
treatment register and contains repeatable patient entries covering
registration, treatment initiation, diagnosis and baseline investigations,
longitudinal bacteriological follow-up, TB/HIV activities and treatment
outcomes.

mapping.name: NG DR-TB Treatment Register Column Mapping
mapping.comment:
Maps NgDRTBTreatmentRegister logical-model elements to the attached
NTBLCP DR-TB Treatment Register.

element.definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme DR-TB Treatment Register. One model instance represents a DR-TB
treatment register and contains repeatable patient entries covering
registration, treatment initiation, diagnosis and baseline investigations,
longitudinal bacteriological follow-up, TB/HIV activities and treatment
outcomes.
Identifier assigned to the DR-TB treatment register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the DR-TB treatment unit or facility maintaining the register, when available.
Name of the DR-TB treatment unit or facility maintaining the register.

element.definition: State in which the DR-TB register is maintained.

Reporting month shown on the continuation/follow-up page of the source register.
Reporting year shown on the continuation/follow-up page of the source register.
One longitudinal patient row in the DR-TB Treatment Register.
